source.title: WCA Continental Championships 2026 Host Cities Announcement (October 2025)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WCA Major Championships Team (WMCT) is happy to announce that the following cities have been selected to host 2026 WCA Continental Championships:

* The WCA African Championship will be held in Cape Town, South Africa.
* The WCA Asian Championship will be held in Shenyang, China.
* The WCA Oceanic Championship will be held in Auckland, New Zealand.
* The WCA South American Championship will be held in Bogotá, Colombia.

We would also like to thank Santa Cruz, Bolivia and Viña del Mar, Chile for applying for the WCA South American Championship, as well as Xi’an, China and Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia for applying for the WCA Asian Championship.

The WMCT is committed to support all organizing teams through the entire process. We are confident these events will showcase the dedication and talent of speedcubers from every continent, while providing a remarkable and memorable experience that the WCA community has come to expect.


You can view the application documents below:

* [WCA African Championship Applications](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1I41M7JJFKXzC2ildBF2hTnGjqzGVTBXK?usp=drive_link)
* [WCA Asian Championship Applications](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NHudV5xhAgt0kGJ0EGKERN0TgM5XzQjM?usp=drive_link)
* [WCA Oceanic Championship Applications](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14MhBzylH6QukarIdwtyLtt7k6kmYomlh?usp=drive_link)
* [WCA South American Championship Applications](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kddZCm0tted5jm35VPk2-nFne3xECQjJ?usp=sharing)



Auckland and Cape Town were the only applicants for their respective Continental Championship. The WCA European Championship was already selected to be held in Arnhem, The Netherlands. See the post on this [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-european-championship-2026-announcement).

translation.title: 2026 年 WCA 各洲锦标赛举办城市公告（2025 年 10 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 大型锦标赛团队（WMCT）很高兴地宣布，以下城市已获选举办 2026 年 WCA 各洲锦标赛：

* WCA 非洲锦标赛将在南非开普敦举行。
* WCA 亚洲锦标赛将在中国沈阳举行。
* WCA 大洋洲锦标赛将在新西兰奥克兰举行。
* WCA 南美洲锦标赛将在哥伦比亚波哥大举行。

同时，感谢玻利维亚圣克鲁斯和智利比尼亚德尔马申办 WCA 南美洲锦标赛，也感谢中国西安和蒙古国乌兰巴托申办 WCA 亚洲锦标赛。

WMCT 将在整个筹备过程中支持所有主办团队。我们相信，这些比赛既能展现各洲魔友的热情和实力，也能带来 WCA 社区所期待的精彩、难忘的参赛体验。

各项比赛的申办材料如下：

* [WCA 非洲锦标赛申办材料](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1I41M7JJFKXzC2ildBF2hTnGjqzGVTBXK?usp=drive_link)
* [WCA 亚洲锦标赛申办材料](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1NHudV5xhAgt0kGJ0EGKERN0TgM5XzQjM?usp=drive_link)
* [WCA 大洋洲锦标赛申办材料](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14MhBzylH6QukarIdwtyLtt7k6kmYomlh?usp=drive_link)
* [WCA 南美洲锦标赛申办材料](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1kddZCm0tted5jm35VPk2-nFne3xECQjJ?usp=sharing)

奥克兰和开普敦分别是所在洲锦标赛的唯一申办城市。WCA 欧洲锦标赛此前已确定在荷兰阿纳姆举行，相关公告见[这里](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/posts/wca-european-championship-2026-announcement)。
